notes: Cognitive walkthrough (four-question variant) of book-a-slot at 375 px, light theme. Record: cw/book-a-slot.json. 8 steps walked, 6 with a 'no'; journey verdict would_with_effort. Probe paths are relative to the run directory. All candidates are E0 failure-point hypotheses, not observations of users. The journey file's _comment names a ground-truth file; it was not opened.

strengths.title: Check-and-book summary restates day, 09:20 to 09:40 window, vehicle and waste with change links
strengths.evidence: probes/10/screenshots/confirm.png; helps the first-time resident confirm choices before booking

strengths.title: Day buttons use the resident's own words ('Saturday 17', 'Tomorrow') instead of a calendar
Field hints explain why each detail is asked (reminder, district check) and give a UK registration example

candidates.title: Slot area shows the previous day's date over an empty list while the chosen day's slots load
candidates.description: After a day is chosen, the slot area should show that it is loading slots for that day. After tapping 'Saturday 17', the slot group empties and the caption still reads 'Monday 12 October' for about a second, with no loading text, before Saturday's slots appear.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident who does not know slots take a moment may read the empty list under today's date as 'no slots on Saturday' or as a missed tap, and may tap again or switch to another day.

evidence.detail: 400 ms after tapping Saturday 17: Slots caption 'Monday 12 October', slot group empty, no status text (final.png, aria.yml)

factor_notes.frequency: every day change, including the first one on every booking
factor_notes.impact: may lead to repeated taps or choosing another day
factor_notes.persistence: repeats each time a day is chosen

candidates.recommendation: Update the caption to the chosen day at once and show a 'Loading Saturday's slots…' status in the slot area.

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots are moved into an unheaded block above 'Morning', out of time order
candidates.description: Slots should read in time order under clear morning and afternoon headings. On Saturday the ten 'Few left' slots (08:20 to 16:40, morning and afternoon mixed) appear first in a block with no heading; the 'Morning' heading below then shows only 08:00, 09:20 and 10:00 as bookable plus three 'Full'. The accessible order differs: the ARIA tree lists all slots chronologically under 'Morning' and 'Afternoon'.
candidates.impact: A resident looking for 'Saturday morning' may take the 'Morning' group as the whole morning and conclude it is nearly full, or not realise the top block holds morning times; sighted and screen-reader users get different orders.

evidence.detail: group 'Slots': heading Morning, 08:00, 08:20 Few left, 08:40 Few left ... in time order

factor_notes.frequency: every day with any 'Few left' slot
factor_notes.impact: misreads availability for the wanted half-day
factor_notes.persistence: does not go away with familiarity for occasional users

candidates.recommendation: Keep slots in time order inside Morning and Afternoon and mark scarce ones in place.

candidates.title: Slot hold and its time limit are not stated after choosing a slot
candidates.description: Once a slot is chosen and the resident continues, the flow should say the slot is held for them and for how long. The vehicle page does not mention the chosen slot or any hold; the only signal is an error on the final step, 'This slot is no longer available', with the slot cleared from the summary.
candidates.impact: A resident booking on a phone while doing other things, who does not know slots are held only briefly, may pause and lose the slot, finding out only after filling in all details.

locations.snippet: This slot is no longer available.

evidence.detail: vehicle page: no text about the chosen slot or a hold
expired hold: 'There is a problem / This slot is no longer available', Slot shown as '–'

factor_notes.frequency: every booking carries the hold; expiry only when the resident pauses
factor_notes.impact: lost slot and repeated work at the last step
factor_notes.persistence: occasional users will not remember the limit between bookings

candidates.recommendation: After a slot is chosen, show 'Saturday 17, 09:20 held for you for N minutes' on the following pages.

candidates.title: Permit number field stays shown, unmarked, after 'Car' is chosen
candidates.description: A field that applies only to vans and trailers should be hidden or labelled as such for a car. After 'Car' is pressed, 'Permit number — Starts DRC-, then five digits.' remains directly below with an empty text box, not marked optional and with no 'vans and trailers only'. The explanation sits behind an icon-only 'i' button.
candidates.impact: A car owner who does not know only vans and trailers need permits may believe they need one, stop to look for it, or abandon the booking.

evidence.detail: Car pressed; Permit number field still shown below
Next with permit empty proceeds to confirm, so the field is not required for a car

factor_notes.frequency: every car booking (the most common case)
factor_notes.impact: hesitation or abandonment at step 2 of 3

candidates.recommendation: Show the permit field only for 'Car with trailer' and 'Van', or label it 'Vans and trailers only'.

candidates.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state while the booking is made
candidates.description: A submit that takes more than a moment should acknowledge the tap. For about 1.5 s after tapping 'Book this slot' the page is unchanged: same label, no status text, button not disabled.
candidates.impact: A resident may tap again, unsure whether the booking went through, risking a duplicate attempt against a two-slots-a-week limit.

evidence.detail: screenshots/just-after-book.png taken right after the tap shows the unchanged form; 'Show this at the gate' appeared after ~1550 ms

candidates.recommendation: Change the button to 'Booking…', disable it and announce the status while the request runs.

candidates.title: Booking confirmation omits the day, the arrival window and the vehicle
candidates.description: The confirmation a resident shows at the gate should restate when to come and what was booked. The 'Booked' page shows the reference and gate instructions but not Saturday 17 October, 09:20 to 09:40, the vehicle or the registration, and does not say to arrive within the 20-minute window.
candidates.impact: A resident who did not know slots are 20-minute arrival windows may leave without a record on screen of when to arrive, and at the gate (poor signal) may not be able to check their time or vehicle.

locations.snippet: Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper

evidence.detail: main: heading Booked; region Your reference; region At the centre; link Book another slot. No date, time, vehicle or registration text.

factor_notes.impact: may arrive outside the window or be unable to confirm details at the gate
factor_notes.persistence: the done page is the record residents keep

candidates.recommendation: Repeat day, time window ('arrive between 09:20 and 09:40'), vehicle and registration next to the reference.
